responsibility: Declares the diagnostics subsystem’s public switch for text-art rendering style in human-readable diagnostics. This header defines the enum behind -fdiagnostics-text-art-charset=, covering disabled output and the supported ASCII, Unicode, and emoji character sets, plus the default selection and the initialization entry point that installs the chosen policy into a diagnostic_context, so later locus/path/diagram rendering code can decide whether and how to emit textual diagrams.
